Changsha_policy: Do not immediately hand Changsha/Xiangtan to unsupported Nanjing formations. Japanese cadres, military police, engineers and a mobile reserve hold key crossings, depots and communications while Nanjing police/security elements enter behind them.
roles: administrative reopening only after Japanese tactical control
combat_credit: NONE for capture of Liuyang/Ningxiang/Xiangtan/Changsha. Rear-security effect is endurance and release of Japanese static manpower.
